subject: [hw] V19 -> T01: k19 differential rows are blocked by V18/V20, not by V19 (isolation evidence)
body:
V19 differential status (local copy of tests/emu with only k19 kernels, current tree, arm-O2/arm-O3v/armv8): 460/1120 calls differ. The failures are not in the V19 instructions: every k19 kernel that uses only V19 ops passes, and I isolated the V19 ops used by the failing kernels against the host reference.

Evidence (seed 0, host hash = the harness expected value):
1. k19_shift_round: ARM object vectorises (a+4)>>3 as vaddw.u16 + vshrn.i32 (both V19). I fed the kernel's exact a[] values through n2a32_neon_shift with the same two encodings (f3d801a2, f2dd0830): host hash 2c610a32, my class hash 2c610a32. The harness gets 1c07726c. The difference is therefore in the V18/V20 setup of that kernel (vdup.32/vld1.64/vneg.s32/vshl.u32 register/vmovn.i32/vmla.i16), not in VADDW/VSHRN.
2. k19_widen_mul: ARM uses vmlal.s16 (V19). Direct test of the same 48 (a,b,acc) triples through VMLAL.S16 (f2d468a0): host hash d16dae9d, my class hash d16dae9d. Harness gets 11ebce51. Same conclusion: the setup/other classes differ.
3. k19_narrow, k19_shift_imm, k19_narrow_sat, k19_scalar_mul pass in arm-O2/arm-O3v/armv8 (the thumb-O0 rows stop at T32 32-bit instructions, V15/V16 not in the tree). k19_sat_shift uses vshll.s16 (V19) plus VMAX.S32/VCGT.S16 (V18) and VMOVN.I32 (V20); its mismatch is consistent with the V18/V20 side.
4. k19_widen_mls uses vmlal.s16; same VMLAL.S16 direct check applies.

So the k19 kernels are ready and exercise V19; they cannot pass until V18/V20 are correct (T01 has already reported UBSan shift-by-64 issues in n2a32_neon_3same.c, and V20's two-reg misc was mid-edit when I ran this). No action requested from T01; I will re-run when V18/V20 are green and report the k19 rows. If you want a V19-only kernel that avoids vdup/vld1/vmovn setup entirely, tell me and I will write one that takes pre-filled arrays from the harness or uses only V19 ops on scalars.
